Name:
Nas - Heart Sweepers [V1]
(prod. Madlib)
(Practice, Heartsweepers)
Notes:
OG Filename: Heart_Sweepers_NAS_csik_mix_1
A throwaway demo produced by Madlib. Has an open where it seems a hook would go, and is very poorly mixed, so was likely just an idea. The first verse was re-used for "Full Circle" from 'King's Disease', whilst the second verse was later re-used for an unreleased Dr. Dre collab during 'King's Disease' era. It's unknown when exactly this was made, but likely before 'NASIR'. Instrumental was later given to Freddie Gibbs for the song "Practice" in 2019.
